description: This file defines the HarRouter class for handling HTTP Archive (HAR) based request routing in Playwright, including methods for creating, handling routes, and disposing resources.

classes.name: HarRouter
classes.description: A class for routing network requests based on HAR files, supporting redirect, fulfill, and error actions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to asynchronously create a HarRouter instance by opening a HAR file.

methods.name: addContextRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a BrowserContext to handle requests matching the specified URL pattern.

methods.name: addPageRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a Page to handle requests matching the specified URL pattern.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the HAR file and cleans up resources.
